reviews.title: Confusing pricing - read all of fine print prior to purchase
reviews.text: I was drawn to imemories because of a promotion.  I signed up and paid for what I thought was the total cost to digitize a VHS tape. Upon receipt of the tape, I was contacted by imemories indicating that I needed to make payment before they could process my order?  Upon calling and speaking to a CSR, I learned that if I wanted a USB of the digitized media, I would have to make not only one, but two separate and additional payments: one for the digitization itself and the next for the actual USB.  I still don’t see where all of this information is buried on the website.  I imagine it is there somewhere, but certainly not readily apparent, so it seems fairly deceptive to me.  The one thing I will commend them for is the helpful representative who refunded my original payment to offset the additional charge to have my VHS tape returned to me (unconverted).

reviews.title: Too expensive
reviews.text: Be prepared to spend over $30 in shipping costs JUST to receive a box and get your original media back.

reviews.title: Hidden costs does not allow full download of material
reviews.text: Customer service delayed response hidden cost does not download effectively.

reviews.title: Beware
reviews.text: They make it seem like you have unlimited access to your movies in their cloud and then they send you a sudden warning at 30 days requiring you pay to access your films in the cloud. A rip off. Download your movies as soon as you get them and be done with their cloud service.

reviews.title: Won’t stay open
reviews.text: Shuts down constantly in the middle of playing videos

reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: This was way more expensive than other options. They got me with the free shipping, just to charge $18 to ship the tape back. Paid $25 for a 12 minute digital copy, then you have to pay monthly or annual to have access to rewatch your videos? Scam.

reviews.title: Total fraud
reviews.text: Went thru walgreens.  Didn’t want dvds, wanted to download onto pc.  Haven’t had a dvd player in 15 years.  Paid $175 No email communication.  Got on site, said 1 week to dl otherwise call for permission to download.  I kid you not.  I call.  On hold for 45 minutes, whole time #1 in queue, w the time remaining 2:15 & 3:15 for the whole time.  Refusing to pay for cloud, says if i dont pay, videos will be deleted.  Watched the YouTube video provided for help.  Comment section full of complaints and turned off.  Contacted Walgreens to get my items returned, still not a single email during the whole process.   Got $150 back.  Vhs tapes returned, thank you for that.  This is a scammy front.  Do not use this company.

reviews.text: $60 a year to have black screen videos that dont play

reviews.title: No technical support
reviews.text: The app stopped working on my son's iPad. Deleting and reinstalling did not help. So I called iMemories customer support and was told that they provide no support for their app.  So we are stuck.

reviews.title: Streaming video just doesn’t work
reviews.text: Do I spent a few hundred dollars getting old videos digitized. The entire process was great. However, when trying to stream through the app, the video constantly freezes and continues to play sound but the video is frozen. Give stars for the process but one star for the app. A streaming video service that won’t stream is pretty useless.

reviews.title: Waste of time and money.
reviews.text:
I sent in original negatives from my parent’s wedding from 1958. The pictures I received back after paying for AI enhancement had strange lighter swirl marks on some of the pictures. This may have been from marks on the original negatives. But I could have used a basic photoshop utility to blend in the lightened marks. If AI can restore faded and grainy pictures as has been advertised. Then I’d like to know why this company could blend the colors/shade of lighting to create a clearer picture. 
Very disappointed and sent in an e-mail sharing that with customer service & have yet to hear a single thing back from them. 

Don’t waste your money.
